title: Tiangan-1 Space Poet Project
subtitle: Collaborative project between China Academy of Art and Shanghai Aerospace Exploration Media

mainContent.content: An IED collaboration connecting popular imagination of orbit with poetic storytelling. Sculptural installations evoke the Tiangan-1 satellite, blending engineering authenticity with artistic vision.
A close-up of the Tiangan-1 satellite sculpture suspended by wires. Internal LED illumination creates a sense of life within the mechanical shell.

content.title: Tiangan-1 sculpture installation with internal LED illumination, suspended by wires in exhibition space

mainContent.content: The full installation shows the sculpture suspended in the exhibition space, evoking orbital weightlessness through its hanging presentation.

Technical satellite designs become hanging installations audiences can walk around. Light creates life within the mechanical shell. Suspension evokes both orbital weightlessness and theatrical revelation.
